decision_basis: All 144 final answers inspected against the unchanged gold rubric. Each baseline run answers 17/24 correctly; each candidate run answers 20/24 correctly. a06, a11 and a16 improve in all three repeats, with no correctness regression among the other 21 questions. Retrieval-only comparison gives no evidence-recall benefit for hybrid over dense at the same k.
selected_configuration: Dense Top5; unchanged cosine threshold0.35 and16000-character ceiling; generic completeness/table-copy prompt; unchanged citation validator; zero repair retries.
limitations: Same small development set, agent-assisted non-blind adjudication; Top5 supplies more context, and prompt changes are a bundled intervention. No statistical-significance or generalizability claim. a18 still lacks a verified table-year-header bundle despite a numerically correct answer.
holdout_policy: Selection made before any holdout query embedding, retrieval evaluation or chat generation. Preserve the selected implementation hashes and do not tune after observing holdout outputs.
